claim: citation_resolver.py doi uses https://api.crossref.org/works as the canonical CrossRef API endpoint for DOI resolution
sub_question: Which API does citation_resolver.py doi use as the canonical CrossRef endpoint for resolving DOIs?
evidence: Module constant CROSSREF_API is set to https://api.crossref.org/works; resolve_doi_crossref builds the request URL as CROSSREF_API plus the quoted DOI.
notes: Verified in scripts/citation_resolver.py lines 58 and 182-184; resolve_doi defaults to Crossref first in auto mode.
